apps.name: Nightcore
apps.what: A local-first desktop studio that runs Claude as an autonomous development team.
apps.body: Describe work as cards on a board. Agents plan, build and test in parallel, each in its own git worktree, and nothing merges on trust: every change passes build, lint, typecheck, the project's own structure rules and an independent reviewer agent before it can reach your branch. Codex is an optional second provider.
apps.statusNote: Dependency and security updates and fixes to what exists, no new features.
facts: Rust and Tauri, over a Bun provider sidecar

apps.name: Nysia
apps.body: Every tab is an agent or a shell session over a headless nysiad daemon that owns the terminals and the orchestration state, so the window can close or crash without interrupting a running agent. Tasks come from GitHub Issues and start in branch-keyed worktrees.
apps.statusNote: Projects and tasks work today; the worktree manager is planned for v0.4. No binary release yet.
facts: Tauri v2 and Rust, one binary that is both daemon and CLI

families.name: auth
families.what: Authentication for TypeScript servers in the spirit of Lucia: sessions, Argon2id passwords, one-time tokens, throttling, CSRF and enumeration-safe flows over storage interfaces, one readable module per attack.
families.status: Early development: 0.5 previews on npm, not for production yet
families.note: All five packages share one version.
packages: auth
The framework-free core: sessions, passwords, one-time tokens, throttling and flows, with two-factor, membership and invitations as subpaths.
auth-redis
Session, counter, two-factor and membership stores on ioredis.
auth-prisma
Prisma 7 user, token, two-factor and membership stores, plus the schema to merge.
auth-nestjs
A closed-by-default session guard, CSRF middleware, decorators and trust-proxy setup.
auth-trpc
Session context, guarded procedures, CSRF on mutations and safe error mapping.

families.name: harness
families.promise: Hold a repo to its own rules.
families.what: A check runner over a committed manifest, a lint-meta engine for whole-repo rules ESLint cannot reach, ready-made rules and zizmor, actionlint and gitleaks pinned to an exact version. Runs in any CI.
families.status: 0.6.0 on npm, zero runtime dependencies, no network
packages: harness
harness check runs the manifest, harness lint-meta the whole-repo rules, harness catalog documents them.

families.name: eslint-plugins
families.what: Fifteen focused plugins, a shared utils package and a catalog of whole-repo lint-meta rules, for architecture, contract, data-integrity and safety problems generic linters cannot see.
families.status: Shipped: flat config, ESLint 9+, each plugin versioned on its own
families.note: New here? Start with code-quality, async-safety and contracts.
packages: eslint-plugin-code-quality
Guard clauses, comment and test hygiene, deterministic time.
eslint-plugin-async-safety
Fetch timeouts, AbortSignal forwarding, async races.
eslint-plugin-contracts
IO boundaries, error taxonomy, schema naming, env access, money.
eslint-plugin-security
Shell injection, path traversal, SSRF, open redirect, XSS.
eslint-plugin-observability
Structured logs, no sensitive fields, no lost error detail.
eslint-plugin-react
Prop drilling, state colocation, effect safety, web storage.
eslint-plugin-rsc
Server Components: navigation errors that must not be swallowed.
eslint-plugin-llm
LLM output treated as untrusted input before a sink.
eslint-plugin-nestjs
Queue jobs keyed against retries, schedules with a time zone.
eslint-plugin-query
TanStack Query and tRPC cache correctness.
eslint-plugin-electron
Renderer isolation flags, IPC sender checks, one shell module.
eslint-plugin-dates
Calendar days read in one zone, date-only parsing.
eslint-plugin-prisma
Tenancy, soft-delete, raw SQL and transaction guardrails.
eslint-plugin-architecture
Folder per component, barrels, feature boundaries.
eslint-plugin-monorepo
Workspace package boundaries and exports-aware imports.
lint-meta-rules
Whole-repo rules ESLint cannot reach, run by harness lint-meta.
eslint-utils
The rule creator and AST helpers the plugins are built on.

families.name: showcase-kit
families.what: Capture, frame and export showcase images of desktop, web and terminal apps for READMEs and portfolios, from one config file. Playwright drives the app and captures the same pixels on every run.
families.note: Needs Node 22 and Playwright 1.50 or newer.
packages: showcase-kit
The showcase CLI: raw captures, framed README images, portfolio images, hero banners, terminal clips and app icons.
